content:
While the outside world is debating whether Apple will include photo and video capture capabilities in its upcoming glasses product, DuckDuckGo has gone one step further...

This privacy-first search engine company is selling a pair of sunglasses called DuckDuckGo Paso Robles, with the slogan 'normal fucking sunglasses'.

The product benefits listed by the company include infinite battery life, guaranteed zero notifications, and 'seamless offline mode'.

Although the company is clearly using a satirical approach to highlight privacy issues, these glasses do actually exist and can be purchased. This is quite a clever PR move.
